brand_voice_note: Cheeky, warm, and celebration-obsessed - a small local candy team that turns every milestone into a fluffy, surprising, joy-first moment.

concepts.product_title: Dirty Soda Mini Cotton Candy Tub Collection
concepts.primary_text:
Dirty sodas went from your local drive-thru to your whole feed. Now they're cotton candy.

Six trending soda-shop flavours spun into fluffy tubs you eat, not sip. Classic, Glamping, Bright Sprite, Cherry Dr Pepper, Creamsicle and Watermelon Mint.

Limited edition. Once this collection's gone, it's gone. Sip the trend while you can. 🥤
concepts.headline: Your Soda Fix, Puffed
concepts.why_it_works: Dirty sodas are a viral cultural moment, so leaning on 'if you know, you know' popularity is the strongest lever for a trend-driven limited-edition set.
concepts.visual_direction: The six pastel cotton candy tubs clustered in a pyramid on a marble counter beside a fizzy soda over ice and a lime half.

concepts.primary_text:
That birthday photo everyone remembers? It has a number in it.

Our Numbered Cotton Candy Cake is an edible milestone spun entirely from fluffy floss. Birthdays, back-to-school firsts, jersey numbers, big anniversaries - pick your number and your colours.

Make the moment bigger, bolder, and way sweeter. Ships across Canada, coast to coast.
concepts.headline: Turn The Moment Into A Number
concepts.why_it_works: This product exists purely to mark occasions, so tying it to the exact celebration moments it was built for is the natural pull for gift-buyers and party planners.
concepts.visual_direction: A fluffy cotton candy numeral cake on a white plate as the centrepiece of a pastel birthday table with balloons and party plates.

concepts.primary_text:
Worried a candy platter won't feed the whole party? Do the math with us.

The Large Candy Platter brings 10 to 15 candy types, around 5kg of sweets, and serves 20 to 40 guests. It even reseals with a lid so leftovers stay fresh.

Pizza parties just aren't cuttin' it. Spread the joy instead.
concepts.headline: Enough Candy For The Whole Crew
concepts.why_it_works: At $175 the biggest hesitation is 'will it actually be enough,' so stacking the real capacity specs inside the creative answers that doubt before the click.
concepts.visual_direction: An overhead shot of the loaded square candy platter with four thin callout lines pointing to labels about its size, weight, servings and resealable lid.
